services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: A field trip to Seattle Children’s Theatre is more than just a performance-it’s a powerful learning experience for young audiences. Designed specifically for preschool through high school students, our weekday student matinees bring imaginative, age-appropriate stories to life onstage. SCT welcomes schools, Montessori programs, preschools, and daycares from across the region to experience live theatre that sparks creativity, builds empathy, and inspires discovery. Booking is simple for groups of 10 or more-just submit your request form. Smaller groups? Give us a call or email, and we’ll help get you set up. Homeschool families can find their dedicated options on our Homeschool Field Trips
